notes.title: Possible Delay of the Steam Version Release
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for your continued support of SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim.

In regard to the Steam release of SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim, the final review by Valve is taking longer than expected, and there is a possibility that the release may be delayed beyond the originally scheduled date of May 29th.

Although the build was submitted with sufficient lead time, the review process is taking longer than expected due to checks related to certain in-game expressions.
We are in active communication with Valve and working hard to resolve the issue as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any concern or inconvenience caused to our Steam users.

Please note that the same version of the game is already available on DLsite and Stove.

We will provide an update as soon as there are any changes regarding the Steam release.
Thank you very much for your continued support.

notes.title: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim. At this time, we are sorry to announce that the highly anticipated adventure game, SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim, by SAFE HAVN STUDIO, will be delayed from 2024 to the first half of 2025. 

The overwhelmingly positive reception of the demo and participation in Steam Next Fest is heartwarming, and has acted as great motivation for everyone to work towards improving the quality of the game, so that all players will be satisfied. We appreciate your continued support and hope you will be able to wait a little longer until the release of the game.
(We will notify you again once a specific release date has been decided upon.)

We again apologize for any inconveniences caused to anyone who was looking forward to the original release.

We appreciate your understanding at this time.

[img]https://hyperreal.jp/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/enkisorry_L.png[/img]

[b][u]■Comment from SAFE HAVN STUDIO[/u][/b]
[quote=author] We apologize for delaying SAEKO, and in effect, making our fans wait longer for the release. As development picked up, our desire to put as much effort into this story and release the game in as perfect a state as possible grew stronger and stronger, leading us to come to this decision.

The development work is progressing smoothly, and we have written a satisfying ending to the story of Saeko and her little people. We will continue to do our best to deliver this story as a playable experience that will remain in your memories for decades to come. We hope you will look forward to it for a little while longer.

(PS: As an apology, the trial version soundtrack is available for free on Youtube! We hope you will listen to it while you wait.)

[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLhB41OFPSrq9h1rPrccs_668lQ4VwobHg]Click here for the trial version soundtrack:[/url]

 [/quote]

Experience the fate of Saeko and little people with an avant-garde art style and brutal yet captivating storytelling.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492120/SAEKO_Giantess_Dating_Sim/


[u][b]About the Game[/b][/u]
SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is an adventure game set in 2000s Japan about the life of Saeko, a girl with strange abilities, and a group of little people who have shrunk to the size of her thumb.
You play as Rin, a new member protected by Saeko, who lives in a desk drawer with other people.
But be careful. Saeko seems to have a few ...... unusual hobbies.

notes.title: Regarding videos/streaming and derivative work for this game
notes.notes:
Thank you for considering video-posting/streaming or derivative works for our game!
We welcome and appreciate almost every collaboration, but please review the following guidelines before you do it.

[h3]Video Posting and Live Broadcasting[/h3]
We welcome video posting and live broadcasting of this game! It's ok to monetize your work through advertisements and donations too.
However, please observe the following two points when you do it:

1. Please include the following link in the description of your video or livestream.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492120/SAEKO_Giantess_Dating_Sim/

2. This work is heavily influenced by novels by Sizue Fuechi. Please respect him, and don't do anything that can hurt his dignity or personality.

Note: well, you can hurt SAFE HAVN STUDIO instead, the developers of this game (within the bounds of law and common sense, of course).

◯ "Whoever made this game must be quite a pervert."
✗ "Whoever wrote the original story must be quite a pervert."

[h3]Illustrations, Doujinshi, Goods production etc.[/h3]
You can freely create derivative works such as illustrations, novels, and goods!
You can distribute your works for a fee, whether through physical media or downloads, as long as the activities are within the scope of personal hobbies. You can also earn revenue through paid sites such as Fanbox and Skeb.
However, please refrain from using official materials as is. Also, please refrain from using expressions that can damage Sizue Fuechi.

[h3]Singing and/or soundtrack remixes[/h3]
You can freely sing or remix our soundtrack, and publish it on internet!
You can distribute your works for a fee, whether through physical media or downloads, as long as the activities are within the scope of personal hobbies. You can also earn revenue through paid sites such as Fanbox and Skeb.
You can sample our songs and soundtracks too -- but don't make anything that can damage Sizue Fuechi.
